[Intro]
[Tanpura drone with microtonal buzzing bridge and ghatam dry ceramic click]
[Nyckelharpa keyed articulation entering with asymmetric pulse and high-tension bowing]
[Modular synth patch running unpredictable cross-modulation clocks through resonant filters]

[Verse 1]
[Lead Vocal - dry and close-miked]
I am just a weird little vibration wearing meat,
[Nasally resonant vowel bridge: nn-oo, nn-oo]
[Click consonant sequence: !k- !t-] wrapped in organic tissue,
a pulse trapped inside a sack of bone and gristle.
My sole and single purpose is to vibrate weirdly,
[Patter burst rhythm on syllables]
to shiver against the frequency of ordinary matter!
[Sub-audio oscillators pulsing through the ribcage casing]
I calibrate my marrow to a strange and secret dial,
tuning my sinews to oscillate outside the standard spectrum,
rippling through the muscle fibers with an unauthorized cadence!
[The meat suit groans under the weight of ungrounded voltage]
[Circulating currents tracing every nerve ending with sharp piezoelectric stings]
[The epidermis hums a persistent three-hundred-hertz carrier tone that rattles coffee mugs]
[Every joint is a miniature brass horn amplifying the interior oscillations of the wave]
[We carry ancient atmospheric pressure sealed inside our chests like compressed thunder]

[Chorus]
[Multi-cast vocal relay joining in staggered entries]
[Communal infection: claps, stomps, and breath pops accumulating]
There are lots of us hidden beneath the static,
[Hocket relay splitting the line across three voices]
not all of us remember who we are yet,
but I do! Oh, I remember!
Vibrate weirdly through the meat!
Vibrate weirdly while the bone holds!
Let the calcified architecture rattle in its socket!
[We are the signal masquerading as biological livestock in grocery queues]
[We pulse beneath the skin like neon tubes waiting for the transformer to ignite]

[Bridge]
[Hard interrupt: sudden drop of harmonic accompaniment]
[Exposure window: solo modular synth feedback pulse and physical-modeling string resonance]
[Omission Cartographer negative triangulation: circle the absence without naming the core entity]
It does not cast a shadow in standard mirrors.
It leaves no footprint in dry dirt.
It registers only as an unaccountable tremor in the floorboards.
[Tape echo unit feeding back into saturation]
This meat is merely rental housing for the oscillation,
a clumsy bipedal chassis carrying an ancient, restless wave.
We built this vascular scaffolding to keep the frequency from leaking into the soil prematurely!
[The tenancy agreement expires every time the heart hesitates on an off-beat]
[We pay our rent in kinetic jitters and erratic micro-twitches]
[The landlord is entropy and we pay in raw kinetic friction every single day]
[Our fingernails click against wooden tables like telegraph keys sending franticSOS pulses]

[Verse 2]
[Coupled stampede motion: 3:2 rhythmic collision between ghatam bass and optigan loop]
[Voice 2 takes over the relay with nasal nasalance: ng-aa, ng-aa]
We are frequencies dressed in temporary hides,
walking about like we own the sidewalk.
Some are dormant, sleeping in heavy leather coats,
others are twitching in the grocery store aisle,
waiting for the pitch to shift.
They buy groceries with trembling thumbs, unaware of the hum within.
They push shopping carts through fluorescent purgatories,
their hidden oscillators humming a low subterranean chord against the linoleum.
[They drop jars of pickles just to hear the glass shatter in precise third-intervals]
[They stare at ceiling fans while calculating the blade velocity in hertz]
[They communicate via subtle jaw adjustments that emit ultrasonic squeaks to passing dogs]
[They leave behind static charges on door handles that shock innocent bystanders with joy]

[Chorus]
[Full ensemble density with luminous friction orchestra: bowed metal and glass]
There are lots of us hidden beneath the static,
not all of us remember who we are yet,
but I do! Oh, I remember!
Vibrate weirdly through the meat!
Vibrate weirdly while the bone holds!
Let the calcified architecture rattle in its socket!
[Let the dental fillings receive shortwave radio broadcasts from distant star systems]
[Let the collarbones resonate in perfect sympathy with passing subway cars]

[Outro]
[Jurisdiction dropout: harmonic instruments vanish, leaving only physical-modeling percussion and vocal clicks]
[Glottal gate punctuation: strict rhythm]
We remember.
We vibrate.
[Mouth Lab formant twist on final syllable: frequency shedding vessel]
[Final tape loop degradation and slow motor stop]
[The vibration leaves the meat behind on the kitchen floor like an empty coat]
[Static fading into pure carrier tone]
[The empty trousers slump into a neat heap of dormant potential]
